links.outcome: Documentation time, after-hours work, note closure and wRVU after ambient AI scribe deployment
links.effect: Note writing time fell 7% at day 0 and 16% by day 150; pajama time fell 19%, TOSH fell 13%, and wRVU rose 2% (IRR 1.02) at day 150, with no wRVU change at day 0.
links.quote: There was no change in pajama time, TOSH, or wRVU at day 0; however, at day 150, there was a 19% decrease in pajama time (0.81, 95% CI [0.73, 0.90]), 13% decrease in TOSH (0.87, 95% CI [0.77, 0.98]), and a 2% increase in wRVU (1.02, 95% CI [1.01, 1.04]).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of real-world ambient AI scribe deployment assessing documentation burden and clinician productivity over time, but does not compare or evaluate a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
